sanskrit_verse:
शस्त्रावपाते गर्भस्य पातने चोत्तमो दमः ।
उत्तमो वाधमो वापि पुरुषस्त्रीप्रमापणे ॥२.२७७
transliteration: śastrāvapāte garbhasya pātane cottamo damaḥ | uttamo vādhamo vāpi puruṣastrīpramāpaṇe || YajñS_2.277
sph_interpretive_translation: In the case of fetal termination caused by weapon-inflicted injury, or in the act of measuring compatibility between man and woman, the highest penalty is applied exclusively to the causal agent who acted with full capacity and intent.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in the causal integrity of action
Causation is determined through pramāṇa-based intent assessment
Capacity-based responsibility escalates with knowledge of consequence
Restoration logic demands cessation of causal distortion
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of sequential manifestation
executable_legal_axioms: IF action results in fetal termination AND agent possesses full sensory-motor and cognitive capacity THEN apply maximum restorative protocol
IF compatibility measurement involves physical harm THEN halt process and initiate consciousness-realignment procedure
IF intent aligns with causal chain THEN assign completion-process responsibility to the agent
IF no intent present THEN evaluate environmental conditions causing involuntary capacity misalignment
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court shall determine threshold of intentional causality based on pramāṇa evidence. Responsibility hierarchy prioritizes agent's capacity to foresee consequence over emotional or social context. Restoration precedes all procedural engagement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes clear causal sequence from intent to outcome. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that consequence follows naturally from distorted consciousness. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity-awareness ratio. No punitive framework required; consequence is self-correcting when consciousness realigns.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process for causal agent until karmic imbalance resolved
Assign Responsibility Assumption Protocol to restore harmonious intent-patterns
Engage Capacity Restoration Mechanism to prevent recurrence
Implement Integrity Reintegration Sequence to reaffirm dharmic alignment
final_declaration: This ruling originates solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is restored through consciousness realignment. Reality operates without punishment. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator.
